In [[mathematics]], in particular in [[topology]], the '''de Groot dual''' (after [[Johannes de Groot]]) of a topology ''τ'' on a [[set (mathematics)|set]] ''X''<!--, named after [[?????? de Groot]], --> is the topology ''τ''* whose [[closed sets]] are generated by [[compact space|compact]] [[saturated set|saturated]] [[subset]]s of (''X'', ''τ'').

== References ==
* R. Kopperman (1995), Asymmetry and duality in topology. ''[[Topology and Its Applications]]'', 66(1), 1&ndash;39, 1995.
